$description: The two official breakpoint sets (Karl, 2026-10-14; EXPORT-STANDARD.md section 6). Input for make-tokens.py. Breakpoints are min-width boundaries; Figma frame widths are documentation, not tokens. Changing a value or adding a breakpoint needs Karl's review (review branch + pull request).

device.description: MNG Device breakpoints (core). Min-width boundaries matching the Figma screen widths 340 / 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1280. fold (340) is the smallest supported width. Reader Dashboard today; every product eventually. Production drift: design-vs-production.md entry 28.

tokens.name: fold
tokens.description: Fold (narrow and folding phones), 340px and up. The smallest supported width (Karl, 2026-10-14).

tokens.name: tablet-landscape
tokens.description: Tablet horizontal, 1024px and up. Reader Dashboard's layout switches here.

wordpressGrid.description: WordPress grid breakpoints (WordPress layer, legacy). From the WordPress themes' grid (16 columns x 80px, 20px gutters, 1280 container). Used by the three shared themes and Obituaries. Retired when WordPress moves to the MNG Device set. Obituaries drift: design-vs-production.md entry 29.

tokens.name: l
tokens.description: Grid l, 1040px and up. The masthead switches to its desktop layout here ($header-primary-bp, all 3 themes).
